'''Hijacked Mobs''' are the Assimilated variants of vanilla mobs that are normally immune to [[Call Of The Hive]], which have been infected directly by [[Gnat|Gnats]]. [[Mobs|Hijacked Mobs]] are roughly equivalent to [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mobs]].

==''Hijacked Mobs''==

==''Spawning''==
*Spawned after a Sane mob immune to COTH with less than 50% health remaining is damaged by a [[Gnat]].
==''Features''==
*Hijacked Mobs' melee attacks will inflict Call Of The Hive I.
*Hijacked Mobs will obtain the Regeneration Effect after killing an entity. The Effect lasts enough to regenerate 1 HP.
*Hijacked Mobs are capable of performing small leaps in liquids.
*Hijacked Mobs are capable of pouncing in order to reach their targets.
===''Weaknesses''===
Like all Parasites, Hijacked Mobs present a weakness to fire (damage inflicted by fire is quadrupled).

{{Properties|tier=Assimilated}}

To be added...

==''Lore''==
Gnats are not able to exactly "infect" the host. Instead, it hijacks the way they work. Gnats do not become a part of the mob, but control it like a puppet. 

==''Trivia''==  
*The Hijacked Blaze is the only parasite immune to fire.
